messages:
katie-cs: Heads up — NectarAI just asked for a Brazil egress pin + a temporary rate bump for a customer demo tomorrow morning. They want ~300 qps for a 4h window, specific CIDRs provided below. This is blocking their demo and could push the renewal timeline. Can ops/sre confirm feasibility? :eyes:

sandeep-ops: Quick check — compliance/billing okay with a temporary region enable? also need exact CIDRs + time window to vet infra changes.

devon-sre: SRE side: capacity looks fine for a 4h burst in sa-east-1 if it's sculpted. We need: exact CIDRs, explicit start/end, auto-revoke, and an agreed rollback plan if latency or token burn spikes.

marta-support: I've opened ticket CS-4872 and emailed Nectar's infra contact for last-mile details. Also flagged as "high-touch" in the account record given the renewal risk.

yusuf-net: Send CIDRs and whether they require peered/dedicated egress vs. general region. We'll do ACL pinning on our side once we have them.

katie-cs: Here are the details they sent (from their infra):
```json
{
  "cidrs": ["200.48.120.0/24", "200.48.121.0/24"],
  "start": "2026-05-09T12:00:00Z",
  "end": "2026-05-09T16:00:00Z",
  "requested_qps": 300,
  "reason": "press demo / exec walkthrough"
}
```

devon-sre: Good. We'll set a canary route to a smaller pool first and have automatic fallback to a lower-cost instance group if SLOs breach. I'll add monitors for latency and token burn and a pager with a 5m escalation.

ticket-bot: Ticket CS-4872 updated: fields changed -> region=sa-east-1, temp_qps=300, cidrs added, auto_revoke=2026-05-09T16:00:00Z. Assigned to devon-sre, yusuf-net.

marta-support: Noted — logging this interaction on the renewal checklist. They're delayed on signature; if demo goes well we escalate to sales for rapid close.

katie-cs: Thanks all. @yusuf-net please reply here once ACLs pushed. @devon-sre confirm monitor + rollback set. We'll ensure auto-revoke at end time.

yusuf-net: ACLs applied to sa-east-1 edge and pinned to NectarAI account. Did a test connect from 200.48.120.12 — successful. Full propagation should be within 5 minutes.

devon-sre: Monitors in place: latency SLO (p95 > 350ms alert), token burn spike alert (>2x expected), and usage anomaly (threshold tied to 300 qps window). Rollback policy: traffic routed back to default hosted pool after 3 sustained SLO breaches.

katie-cs: :thumbsup: I'll update the customer and include the ticket link. Finance — FYI for potential spike on tomorrow's bill.
